description:
Your Zotero library contains citation data imported from various sources (BibTeX, PDFs, etc.), resulting in inconsistent page number formatting. Some papers use double hyphens ('--') or en-dashes ('–') instead of the standard single hyphen ('-').

Task:
1. Locate these three specific papers:
   - 'On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem' (Turing, 1936)
   - 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948)
   - 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' (He et al., 2016)

2. Edit the 'Pages' field for each paper to use a standard single hyphen (e.g., change '100--120' to '100-120').

3. Ensure no double hyphens or en-dashes remain in the Pages fields of these items.

The library is already open. You can find items by searching or scrolling through the list. Edit fields using the Info pane on the right.
